description: the part of tee-unequal-fuse's branch inside its main cylinder: the branch's base cap, its wall inside the main and the main wall inside the branch. The branch's wall meets the main wall in one closed loop of the quartic two cylinders on crossing axes of unequal radii make, traced and fitted as one periodic NURBS (ADR-0018) and paved once, where the branch's seam pierces the main wall; the base cap lies inside the main cylinder. No closed form in the recipe grammar for the volume: the branch inside the main, ∫ 2√(r² − y²)√(R² − y²) dy over |y| ≤ r, an elliptic integral (plans/quadric-intersection-curves step 8). volume_rel, area_rel and inertia_rel are 1e-7 here, the model's linear tolerance taken relative: both bodies' loop edges lie within the tolerance of the exact section, not on it — Arris's fitted to a quarter of it (ADR-0018), Open CASCADE's walked and approximated to it — and each trims the two walls it bounds by as much along the loop, which on a body this small in volume and area reaches past 1e-9 of it. Against a quadrature of the exact loop, the volume 1.077481310112 is 2.5e-9 below Open CASCADE's and 5.1e-9 above Arris's, the area 5.724777344300 1.9e-9 below the one and 4.6e-9 above the other.
